title: Angels fire general manager Perry Minasian amid another disappointing season
content:
The Los Angeles Angels fired general manager Perry Minasian amid another disappointing season for the club, the team announced Friday night. Longtime St. Louis Cardinals executive John Mozeliak was named the interim general manager.

Minasian compiled a 392-500 record over his tenure with the Angels, which was defined by drama, late-season collapses and chaotic roster turnover.

This story will be updated.
